summary: Add a live fail-to-pass gate fixture (scripts/demo-gate-hero.mjs, pnpm demo:gate) for the demo hero, with a test and a changelog entry.

claims.statement: scripts/demo-gate-hero.mjs builds a synthetic repository where an agent PR changes two documents but claims one, so gitpin gate fails with uncovered-change and then passes after one locator is added; src/gate-hero.test.ts asserts both runs through the CLI and the changelog records it.
